title: CourtLens legacy inventory row
description: Schema for one row in docs/courtlens/legacy-inventory.csv. Produced by scripts/courtlens/build_legacy_inventory.py. Every row must eventually be reviewed via docs/courtlens/legacy-inventory-review.json before the refactor branch may open a PR.

legacyPath.description: POSIX relative path from the legacy root (Downloads/court-lens-ready-extracted). Unique across the inventory.

category.description: Grouping bucket assigned by the generator's categorize() rules.

disposition.description: Decision on how the legacy file relates to the Nzila apps/abr rewrite. 'review-required' is the mandatory default for unmapped files — humans must resolve every one before Phase 1 ships.

phase.description: REQUIRED for disposition=port. MUST be empty for any other disposition.

targetPath.description: REQUIRED for disposition=port; must be a workspace-relative path under apps/abr/**. MUST be empty otherwise.

usesBase44.description: True when the file references the base44 SDK — must be rewritten to Nzila services (platform-auth / drizzle / audit-log).

usesUpload.description: True when the file uses upload/blob primitives — Phase 2+ blob storage + antivirus + size limits are prerequisites.

usesAppLanguageContext.description: True when the file consumes AppLanguageContext — replaced by next-intl in apps/abr; port must rewrite the i18n binding.

securityNotes.description: Semicolon-delimited security signals detected by the content scanner (privilege/consent/retention, PII, upload, base44).

dependencyOfPath.description: Optional. When populated, records the legacyPath of the parent file that pulls this one in via import (populated by a follow-up import-graph pass, empty in v0.1.0).

notes.description: Human-authored notes carried forward by _FILE_OVERRIDES in the generator. Free-form.
